subject: Giant Octorok
text: The Giant Octorok is stunned with the Boomerang and can be damaged with sword slashes on its green weak spot on its back, taking about three hits.

evidence.quote: When you hit the miniboss with your Boomerang, he is stunned for a moment but his only weakspot it on the back so you have to run around the circle and try to get his back before he starts up again...The green spot will open up and you can slash it with your sword...He takes about three hits.

subject: Floor button
text: A floor button must be held down by placing one of the two wooden boxes on it.

evidence.quote: Grab one of the two boxes on the side here and them come back over.  You'll notice a button on the floor here, jump on it while carrying a box and then put the box down on the button to hold it down.

subject: Gold Skulltula 027
text: Gold Skulltula 027 is crawling on a wall and can be killed using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: find the Skulltula crawling around on the wall here and kill it with your Boomerang.  Climb the wall to get GOLD SKULLTULA [027].

subject: Door switch
text: The switch on the ceiling behind a glass panel must be hit by throwing the Boomerang around the glass.

evidence.quote: The problem is that there is a  glass panel in your way that means you can hit it straight on with the Fairy Slingshot, you have to use the Boomerang...Stand all the way back and target with L/Z and throw.  It should go around the glass but there's no guarantee it will hit the button.

subject: Barinade chamber pots
text: All of the pots around the room during the Barinade battle contain a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: The first thing to note is that if you're low on health, all of the pots around the room each contain a Recovery Heart which should be enough to get you back to full from being almost dead.

subject: Barinade
text: To defeat Barinade, target and sever its three ceiling attachments with the Boomerang, stun the main body with the Boomerang to slash it, and kill the detached spinning jellyfish enemies with one Boomerang hit each before finishing off the stunned core with sword slashes.

evidence.quote: Use the L/Z button to lock onto the three things that attach the boss to the ceiling and hit all three of them individually with the Boomerang...Aim for the main body part and throw your Boomerang to stun it, if it turns blue then you know it's stunned.  Slash it as much as possible with your sword until you can't hurt it anymore...target the enemies individually and throw you Boomerang at them, it will kill them in one hit.  After all those little enemies are defeated then you can stun the boss and keep attacking with your sword.

subject: Barinade
text: Defeating Barinade leaves a Heart Container on the ground before the warp portal.

evidence.quote: After all those little enemies are defeated then you can stun the boss and keep attacking with your sword.  The enemies never respawn so you are free to keep stunning and attacking until the boss eventually dies.  Grab the HEART CONTAINER on the ground here and then step into the warp portal.

subject: Zora's Sapphire
text: After defeating Barinade and taking the warp portal back to Zora's Domain, agree to acquire the Spiritual Stone to receive Zora's Sapphire.

evidence.quote: Grab the HEART CONTAINER on the ground here and then step into the warp portal.  It will take your back to Zora's Domain, say that you wish to acquire the Spiritual Stone and you will be given ZORA'S SAPPHIRE.

subject: Lost Woods grotto
text: In a hole in the Lost Woods reached by turning right then left from the entrance, bugs can be captured by slashing the grass next to the chest.

evidence.quote: When you enter, make a right and then a left.  There should be a hole in the ground here, drop down and fill all three of your Empty Bottles with bugs, you can find bugs if you slash the grass down here beside the chest.

subject: Sacred Meadow grotto chest
text: Bombing the center of the first area in Sacred Meadow reveals a hole where defeating two wolf enemies causes a chest with a Purple Rupee to appear.

evidence.quote: Place a bomb in the centre of this first area to reveal a hole in the ground and drop down.  There are two wolf enemies which you have to kill here and after they have been defeated a small treasure chest appears containing a PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: Gold Skulltula 028
text: Releasing bugs into the soft soil hole found by turning left twice and heading south from the Lost Woods entrance causes Gold Skulltula 028 to emerge.

evidence.quote: Make a left at the very beginning and then in this next large area make a left again and head south.  In front of you should be a hole in the ground to plant something in...use the Empty Bottle with a bug in it, the bugs will dig down into the hole and a Gold Skulltula will pop out, defeat this enemy to acquire GOLD SKULLTULA [028].

subject: Gold Skulltula 029
text: Dropping bugs into the soft soil hole next to a Deku Scrub in the Lost Woods causes Gold Skulltula 029 to pop out.

evidence.quote: Make a left and then make another left to reach an area with two Deku Scrubs.  Beside one of them you will find another hole in the ground, drop some bugs into it and GOLD SKULLTULA [029] will pop out of the ground.

subject: Gold Skulltula 030
text: Using an Empty Bottle with a bug in it on the hole beside the orange-roofed shop in Kokiri Forest causes Gold Skulltula 030 to pop out.

evidence.quote: In Kokiri Forest again make your way over to the orange roofed shop, beside the shop you will find a hole in the ground.  Use one of your Empty Bottles with a bug in it to make a GOLD SKULLTULA [030] pop out of the hole.

subject: Gold Skulltula 031
text: Inside the Deku Tree on B1, bombing the northwest wall in the upper-left room reveals Gold Skulltula 031, which must be defeated using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Head inside the Deku Tree and drop down the hold right at the very beginning.  Make your way to the upper left room on B1 here, you will find a special wall which must be bombed here that leads northwest...look around on the walls to find the golden one.  You have to use your Boomerang to defeat it and acquire the GOLD SKULLTULA [031].

subject: Hyrule Field grotto chest
text: Blowing up a rock in the middle of trees with spinning flower enemies while traveling southwest toward Lake Hylia reveals a hole with a chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: On your way there you will likely pass through a number of trees with many of those spinning flower enemies, and in the middle of these trees is a rock.  Blow it up and go down to find a RED RUPEE in the small chest.

subject: Business Scrub
text: A Deku Scrub inside a bombed hole within a fenced area near Lake Hylia sells Piece of Heart 016 for ten Rupees after being stunned with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Place a bomb here in the middle and drop down the hole that appears.  Defeat the Deku Scrub using your Boomerang and then speak to it.  The scrub will sell you the PIECE OF HEART [016] for the astounding price of only ten Rupees, you'd be a fool to pass this up.

subject: Gold Skulltula 032
text: Inside a bombed hole in the circle of stones northeast of Gerudo Valley on Hyrule Field, burn the spider web with Din's Fire and use the Boomerang to acquire Gold Skulltula 032.

evidence.quote: Take out a bomb and place it in the middle of this circle to blow a hole in the ground.  Drop down the hole and note three spider webs.  Behind one of them you will see a Gold Skulltula and some pots and grass and stuff, this is the one you want.  Equip Din's Fire on one of your C Buttons and use it while standing beside the spider web...Aim up at the web in the corner and use your Boomerang to acquire the GOLD SKULLTULA [032].

subject: Hyrule Castle drawbridge moat
text: After witnessing the cutscene near the drawbridge of Hyrule Castle, dive into the water under the drawbridge to retrieve the Ocarina of Time.

evidence.quote: When you do there should be some kind of cutscene which occurs when you get near the drawbridge.  Watch the scene and then jump into the water under the drawbridge.  Dive under the pick up the OCARINA OF TIME.

subject: Princess Zelda
text: Princess Zelda teaches the Song of Time after Link retrieves the Ocarina of Time from under the drawbridge.

evidence.quote: Dive under the pick up the OCARINA OF TIME.  She will also teach you the SONG OF TIME as well.

subject: Gold Skulltula 033
text: Bombing beside the tree near the east castle wall along the bridge to Kakariko Village opens a hole where Gold Skulltula 033 can be collected from the wall with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: What you have really been looking for this whole time is the tree, across the bridge leading toward Kakariko village, but directly beside the east wall to the castle on your left.  Place a bomb beside the tree to blast a hole in the ground, then drop down through that hole.  At the bottom there is a normal Skulltula for you to defeat and then you can use your Boomerang to take out the GOLD SKULLTULA [033] on the wall here.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Speaking to the freed person in the House of Skulltula after acquiring more than thirty Gold Skulltulas rewards the Giant's Wallet, which holds up to five hundred Rupees.

evidence.quote: Enter the house and speak with the person here who has been recently freed assuming you have more than thirty Gold Skulltulas.  The person will give you a GIANT'S WALLET which is a special new wallet that allows you to hold a maximum of up to five hundred Rupees!

subject: Kakariko Village grotto chest
text: Bombing east of the center tree in Kakariko Village reveals a hole with two zombies that spawn a chest containing a Huge Rupee worth two hundred Rupees upon defeat.

evidence.quote: Now head a bit east from the three until you seem to be in the exactly middle of everything and the controller should be rumbling, place a bomb here to blast open a hole and then drop down through it.  There are two zombies down here in this area that you are going to have to defeat, then once you do a small chest will appear.  Open the small chest to get a HUGE RUPEE which is worth a whopping two hundred Rupees

subject: Windmill
text: In the room above the stairs leading to the graveyard in Kakariko Village, stand on one of the four grey posts around the spinning platform and throw the Boomerang to collect Piece of Heart 017.

evidence.quote: climb the stairs beside it.  There is a door at the top of the stairs for you to go through.  There is some form of spinning platform here, don't really worry about that for now.  Look up a little and you should see a heart piece in this room.  What you need to do is climb onto one of those four grey coloured posts that surround the spinning thing in the middle and throw your Boomerang to acquire this PIECE OF HEART [017].
